fields.claim: Ice thresholds are for flat quasi-isotropic PAN panels, 1.59-6 mm thick (the T800 table is an interim 2010 snapshot). There are none for tubes, pitch fibres, walls under 1.5 mm or preloaded members. Tube data are hard-impactor only. The 52% CAI retention is a single row.
fields.needed_to_ground: Ice-gun strikes on preloaded full-size tubes of the chosen layup.
